sentence: Every ported app in the corpus with a replay check runs on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows and prints its expected marker, on the same commit.
audience: whoever says Krate runs the same file on every desktop OS, and whoever reads the release notes
exclusions: rssfwd, which is deliberately not replayed because it reaches the internet
anything about how the apps behave beyond printing their marker
Android, iOS and the browser: this is the desktop matrix, and a report labelled every-OS must add those columns (1575)
note: subject.commit and evidence are filled by scripts/e3-matrix.py ingest from the replay job's matrix files; until three hosts have passing records on one commit this stays UNSUPPORTED, which is the truth.
